notes: 0.73.1: stock SDK user-agents only (OpenAI/JS on openai-completions, Anthropic/JS with 'anthropic-beta: interleaved-thinking-2025-05-14' on anthropic-messages), so the identity ('You are an expert coding assistant operating inside pi, a coding agent harness') and the four-tool set read/bash/edit/write carry the verdict; store false and max_completion_tokens on the openai body, cache_control blocks on the anthropic one. Identical across both APIs, the first turn, the tool turn and the -c follow-up. The default prompt and tools can be replaced per project (.pi/SYSTEM.md, --system-prompt, --tools), which would defeat the identity and tool features; openai-responses and google-generative-ai are configurable but were not captured.
